name: Ericka Lesley
office: City of Santa Monica, Member of the City Council

items.text: Ericka Lesley is a member of the Santa Monica Rent Control Board. On the board, she has focused on tenant protections and keeping housing accessible. Her campaign says she works as assistant director of CURELA, a program of Community Build. She previously served on the board of Downtown Santa Monica, Inc.

sentences.text: Ericka Lesley is a member of the Santa Monica Rent Control Board.
On the board, she has focused on tenant protections and keeping housing accessible.
Her campaign says she works as assistant director of CURELA, a program of Community Build.
She previously served on the board of Downtown Santa Monica, Inc.

items.text: She proposes concentrating new housing on commercial corridors, near transit, and on underutilized public land. She wants to protect R2 residential zones. She advocates for a needs-based approach to homelessness and regional burden-sharing for services. She supports full police staffing while emphasizing a community-centered approach to safety. She also proposes local hiring initiatives and strict enforcement of Airbnb regulations.
